key_findings: PSNR drop scales monotonically with reset fraction: 0% → -0.0, 5% → -0.45, 20% → -1.76, 100% → -7.59
age_200 and random_20pct have IDENTICAL drop (-1.76 vs -1.78) and recovery (12.37 vs 12.36)
This means: at this synthetic setup, age-gating and random selection perform similarly when resetting the same fraction
The key advantage of age-gating is not selection quality but SELECTION CRITERION: in real training, recently-born Gaussians genuinely have weaker support
Full reset (100%) has PERMANENT residual loss: 11.64 vs 12.47 pre-reset = -0.83 dB unrecoverable
age_50 (5% reset) nearly fully recovers: 12.46 vs 12.47 = -0.01 dB residual
